notes.title: Azmar Quest 1.4.3 update
notes.content: [p]Azmar Quest has been updated to version [b]1.4.3[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p]• Archer's Quick Shot damage has been slightly increased.[/p][p]• Archer's Poison Arrows base damage has been slightly increased, but now has diminishing returns with each stack.[/p][p]• Cleric's Regrow Life healing has been increased, doesn't reduce target's healing to 0 anymore, but now halves all your healing done.[/p][p][/p][p]• Minimal is now the default setting for dialogues, instead of Standard.[/p][p]• Jessica is now called Jessira.[/p][p]• Fixed the Block Skills feature for some players.[/p]

notes.title: Azmar Quest Story Mode+ Update (1.4.1)
notes.content:
[p]The new [b]1.4.1[/b] Azmar Quest update is now live!   

• New Game Mode: [b]Story Mode Plus[/b]. Replay the Story scaled to level 30 and powered up. Choose which progress to keep at the end.  
• New Scroll: [i]Master of Choices[/i] (unlocked after completing Story Mode+).   

• Updated Bandit's model.  
• Updated Vice's model.  
• Toned down some language and encounters throughout the Story.[/p]

notes.title: Azmar Quest 1.3.24 update
notes.content:
[p]Azmar Quest has been updated to version [b]1.3.24[/b]:

• Azmar Quest now has its official Wiki: [url="https://azmarquest.wiki.gg/"]https://azmarquest.wiki.gg/[/url]. You can find it under Options → Game Info → Game Guide. 

• Changed the music in Azmar (City Theme). 
• Changed the music when Azmar is under attack. 

• Improved some texts in Chapter 3, specifically during the Ashera encounter and the dialogues with Naradhar and Jessica. 

• Improved the Level Up Screen. 
• Added a YouTuber Content Guide Panel on the character selection.[/p]

notes.title: Azmar Quest 1.3.23 update
notes.content:
[p]Azmar Quest has been updated to version [b]1.3.23[/b]:

• Chapter 5 balance: Overdrive no longer heals, and its damage boost is now lower. Dark Servant's Dark Rune now gives you 2 energy. [/p][p]• Helper buffs now last 20 turns (up from 6), and their damage is doubled in Chapters 2, 3, and 5. [/p][p]• The VS screen before battles is now shorter and cleaner. [/p][p]• Improved dialogues in some parts of the story. [/p][p]• Equipping an Armor or Item you are already using now swaps it instantly. [/p][p]• Invite Popups can no longer be dismissed by clicking outside. [/p][p]• Minor font updates across the app. 

• (Bugfix) Fixed a screen resizing bug that could make the game unplayable. [/p][p]• (Bugfix) Fixed music occasionally disappearing forever in Chapters 3 and 5.[/p]

notes.title: Azmar Quest - Developer plays the Story
notes.content: [p]Story Mode attempt in Veteran: let's see how many times I [i]don't[/i] die.[/p]

notes.title: Azmar Quest 1.3.21 + 1.3.22 update
notes.content:
Azmar Quest has been updated from 1.3.20 to version 1.3.22:

[b]1.3.22[/b] change log:

• Fixed a bug that caused the game to break when resizing or alt-tabbing in fullscreen mode.
• Pressing [b]Esc [/b]now opens a quit game confirmation popup.

• Improvements to Chapter 1.
• Added 2 new tutorials: one for [i]Instant Turns[/i] when fighting the Vice, and one for the [i]Skip Turn[/i] button.
• You can now also press [b]Spacebar [/b]to advance the turn.
• Fixed an exploit in the Extra Mission: The Rescue at Vorsall.
• Various text fixes.
• Fixed flickering of dungeon allies' portraits on tablets and PC.
• Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
• Added a Wishlist button in the Steam Demo.

[b]1.3.21[/b] change log:

• Improved the class info popup during character creation. It now shows a brief [b]class description[/b] and all available skills.
• Introduced a new in-game notification when a player joins the Queue for a Dungeon or PvP Battle.
• Optimized real-time in-game notifications for events like friend and duel requests.
• Added a Surrender button during 3v3 Party-Based Battles.

• Fixed an exploit in the first mission that allowed gaining more gold and experience than intended.
• Fixed a bug that granted double rewards in 2v2 Arena Battles.
• Added a gold penalty, based on hero level, for exiting an Extra Mission early.

• You can now click [b]E[/b] or the [b]Middle Mouse[/b] button to advance turn.
• Accessibility: added an option for announcing spoken audio between SAPI and the current screen reader.

notes.title: Azmar Quest 1.3.20 update
notes.content:
Azmar Quest has been updated to version [b]1.3.20[/b]:

• Replaced all select popups with better ones. The affected popups are: Temple's Code, Blackjack's Joker, Wanted Difficulty, Dungeon and 2v2 Invites, Auto-Recycle, and, for Accessibility only, Switch Skill.

• Expanded the PC support, and now the entire single-player campaign works, along with online PvP and Dungeons. The Demo is still limited to the first 2 Chapters.

• Fixed a bug in the swipe tutorial against the first Bandit that prevented the info on how to pass the turn from being displayed.

• Fixed a bug that, after entering the Story, you couldn't hear the music of the character selection anymore.

• Accessibility: Bottom bar buttons are now labeled as tabs.

notes.title: Azmar Quest 1.3.18 minor update
notes.content:
Azmar Quest has been updated to version [b]1.3.18[/b]:

• Fixed a bug that caused an error when creating a save file under certain conditions.
• Fixed a bug where you could open a treasure while pick-locking it if you had a key.
• Changed Azmar Quest's icon.
• Azmar Quest on Steam is now cross-compatible with the mobile version (Beta)

notes.title: Azmar Quest Demo is finally available!
notes.content:
The [b]Azmar Quest[/b] Demo is finally available!

You can play through the first 2 Chapters of the game and get a taste of what's to come in the full game!

[b]What is Azmar Quest?[/b]

Azmar Quest is a text-based RPG, with turn-based battles and old-school vibes. The single-player main story should last at least 20 hours, then there's a lot of additional content! And if you play online, you can also fight in PvP and play Dungeons. Choose your class and let the adventure begin!

[b]Demo Limitations:[/b]

[i]Please note that the demo has the following limitations:

• Only the first 2 Chapters are available. The first chapter is mostly designed to introduce you to the game.
• Only 2 Extra Missions are available.
• The maximum level is 10.
• Most extra game modes (2v2 battles, party-based 3v3 battles) are inaccessible because they require a higher level or specific points in the story to unlock.
• You can only play in single-player mode. You cannot sign in to play online, so you don't have access to PvP battles and online events, and you can't queue for a Dungeon.[/i]

Thanks for trying Azmar Quest! As a [b]solo-developer[/b], I hope you enjoy the demo!
